title: Underived left exact lower truncation on cycles
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories and F:C→D additive and preserving finite limits. For any integer-indexed cochain complex I and n∈ℤ, put J=F(I) and K=F(truncGE n I), and let c:F((I.sc n).homologyData.left.K)→H^n(J) be the unique cycle lift of F of the cycle inclusion followed by the homology projection. There is an isomorphism a:H^n(K)≅F((I.sc n).homologyData.left.H) such that c followed by H^n(F(I.πTruncGE n)) and a equals F of the homology quotient of I. Only preservation of kernels is used; no injective or derived-category hypotheses are required.

source.place: Tag 05TC; kernel calculation underlying Tag 08D4 (1), expanded from the parent cycle-formula proof. Official pages read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: The incoming differential of T=truncGE n I is zero by strict support. Its induced boundary into cycles is zero by cancellation with the monic cycle inclusion. F preserves the kernel of the outgoing differential and the cokernel of this zero boundary. Apply ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.map to the homology data of T.

The truncation projection p:I→T induces an isomorphism on H^n. Define a as the homology comparison of the mapped target data, followed by F of the inverse of H^n(p). Cancel the latter isomorphism to check the cycle formula.

Let gamma be the induced left homology map data of p. Naturality of homologyπ and uniqueness of the lift into the preserved kernel identify the mapped cycle with F(gamma.phiK). The commutation gamma.commπ finishes the formula. These are Mathlib homology-data universal properties, proved in the delivered Lean module.

theorem leftExact_truncation_cycle_formula
    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v'} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    let J := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
    let K := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (I.truncGE n)
    let c := (J.sc n).liftCycles (F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.i) (by
      change F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.i ≫ F.map (I.sc n).g = 0
      rw [← F.map_comp, (I.sc n).homologyData.left.wi, F.map_zero]) ≫
      (J.sc n).homologyπ
    ∃ a : K.homology n ≅ F.obj (I.sc n).homologyData.left.H,
      c ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (I.πTruncGE n)) n ≫ a.hom =
        F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.π
